description: What an action-packed May it has been! This month gave me many opportunities to connect with business and community leaders across Southern Nevada. I attended the Henderson Chamber's Meet the Candidates event, several Vegas Chamber gatherings, and a Latin Chamber luncheon focused on the future of business and transportation in Nevada (planes, trains, and automobiles!) It was exciting to hear directly from leaders who are helping shape our state's future. I'm especially proud to be endorsed by these organizations because it reflects a shared commitment to economic growth, job creation, and keeping Nevada a great place to live and do business.
title: Assembly District 35 June Newsletter!
